source_access: pidfd_open + pidfd_getfd(existing fd) + fstat size validation + mmap PROT_READ; no ioctl, DMA allocation, import or source write

correctness.expected: Every copied visible byte matches reference before and after each variant; varied plane lengths exercise tails

target_method: Use an existing idle output dma-buf exporter t736-ve-wc, confirmed storage1920x1088 I420/YV12, same 1920/960/960 strides. Root runs taskset -c 0 helper --pid BROKER_PID --fd OUTPUT_FD --iterations 8, then CPU6 or7. Compare pinned memory before/after; helper makes no new backing.
limitations: Requires pidfd_getfd permission and kernel support
Only tightly strided visible-width planes with padded storage height are benchmarked
Caller must select an actual idle I420/YV12 output buffer and correct geometry
No inference about end-to-end Firefox frame rate from isolated copy timings; root is testing affinity with the same pipeline.

target_result_report.source: Root agent /root hardware test report; this subagent did not access board
target_result_report.conclusion: Scheduling the existing broker copy work on A76 is the first performance change to test: the same read-only WC source copied through libc-row is about 3.53x faster on CPU6 than CPU0. NEON does not improve the already faster A76 path; no YV12 copy replacement is justified by these measurements.
target_result_report.next_root_action: Pin existing broker threads to CPUs6,7 and measure same-pipeline direct client reuse, without allocating new DMA backing.
